C009.status: SPECULATIVE: C009 was not accepted when C010 was built (its third fix changes tests, README and evidence only; every production file is frozen). Only PRODUCTION files are imported, never C009 tests or evidence. If the controller reports that a production file changed, re-pin here and in imports.test.cjs, and rerun the suites.

dependencies.usedBy: server.cjs (verified identity: createTokenRegistry, parseBearer, AuthError, decide, claimedHeaders)
codes.cjs (the wording of every typed code C009 already says) and, through http-io.cjs, the answers Node gives itself
contract.js (the four identities, the roles, the claim fields and the connection bounds); transitive through authz.cjs
server.cjs (the refusal path: createResponder, createLanes, isFinished, readBody, localGuard, hasBody, clientErrorCode, canStopReading)

notImported: C009 commands.cjs, handlers.cjs, ledger.cjs, server.cjs, cli.cjs, page.js, index.html and style.css are the C009 command pipeline, its public state and its page: C010 does not import them (its state is not public, its mutations are lease-scoped, its page is its own). C009's tests and evidence are never imported. README.md section 'What C010 imports' names the exports it uses.
policy: Read-only imports of accepted producer bytes. Raw working bytes (CRLF here), the LF-normalized bytes and the Git blob of the pinned commit are separate pins (the blob and the LF pin are the canonical ones; the raw pin is accepted OR the LF pin matches, so a fresh LF checkout verifies too). tests\imports.test.cjs recomputes them against git objects (never the index or HEAD). C010 never edits an imported file.
